# Physics mode 3 (menu 270): the world steps only on a settle or while
# playing. Idle passes, a seek, steps forward and back, and a playback.
settle 0
load pmm swing600.pmm
physics mode 3
trace mode3.trace
pump 3 33
frame 300
pump 2 33
step forward
pump 2 33
step back
pump 2 33
play 300 360
pump 5 33
stop
pump 3 33
save pmm mode3.pmm
